selftext:

comments.author: fisj
comments.body: Hey Cerulean. I'm thinking to enforce tags on posts, and wondered what type of tag this post should have. Maybe a "Media" tag?

comments.author: CeruleanSpirit123
comments.body:
This is promotion/advertisement post.  
  
I actually do think the community need these promotion posts because it allow everybody to see what interesting AI projects people are cooking. For me, it allows me to reach them out and cover/promote their games with a video such as the one above. 

I would add 2 flairs:  
  
Self-Promotion: You have a game and want to show it to the community.  
Media: For a media coverage of an AI game (Let's Play, Review, General Discussion Vids...)

replies.author: fisj
replies.body: Thanks for your thoughts. I've added a Media tag for you for future posts.
